 Follow ‘Full House’ Star Candace Cameron Bure Is Returning to ‘The View’ After Previously Turning Down an Invitation
 Terri Peters Sat, November 7, 2026 at 2:26 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. ‘Full House’ Star Candace Cameron Bure Is Returning to ‘The View’ After Previously Turning Down an Invitation Candace Cameron Bure is heading back to  The View  after all.
 The  Full House  star, who previously revealed that she'd turned down an invitation to return to the ABC talk show for its 30th season, is now scheduled to appear on the Friday, Nov. 13 episode.
 According to  ABC's official guest lineup , Bure will return alongside fellow guest Emma Grede , marking her first appearance on the show since 2024.
 The news comes just weeks after Bure explained why she had declined an earlier invitation to return to the Hot Topics table.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In an October interview with  Entertainment Weekly , the actress revealed that producers had reached out about bringing her back for the show's milestone season, but the timing didn't work for her family.
 "They did reach out to me, and they offered me the week that my daughter gave birth, so I knew that was coming," Bure explained.
 Her daughter, Natasha Bure , welcomed her first child with husband Bradley Steven Perry in October.
 Bure said she didn't want to risk missing the birth of her grandchild, but she hadn't completely ruled out appearing on the show again.
 "I didn't want to be far away and miss anything, but I'm definitely open to it," she told the outlet.
 Advertisement Advertisement At the time, the actress acknowledged that she wasn't entirely sure whether she wanted to return to the daytime talk show, where she had previously been a permanent co-host.
 "Yeah, you might see me at the table. We'll see," she said, adding that she was open to another invitation if the timing worked out.
 Now, it appears the scheduling conflict has been resolved.
 Bure joined  The View  as a permanent co-host in 2015 and departed in 2016, citing her commitments to  Fuller House  and her work with Hallmark.
 Although she hasn't been a regular panelist in a decade, she has made guest appearances since leaving, most recently in 2024.
 Advertisement Advertisement Her upcoming visit is part of  The View 's 30th season, which has featured appearances by former co-hosts and other familiar faces.
 Bure's return was also confirmed in a Nov. 6 report from  Entertainment Weekly . Fans can watch her appearance on  The View  on Friday, Nov. 13, on ABC.
